field.label: Enable Client Control
field.help: Saved groups and clients stay in place when this is off. Traffic changes only after you review and apply them.

field.label: Client networks
field.help: Select the interfaces where client traffic enters the firewall. In a typical setup this is LAN.

field.label: Internet interfaces
field.help: Select the interfaces that carry traffic to the internet. In a typical setup this is WAN.

field.label: Work mode
field.help: Preview only shows what would change. Apply rules allows the reviewed access and speed rules to become active.

field.label: Apply rules to
field.help: Choose whether client rules cover all destinations, internet traffic only, or addresses from one existing alias.

field.label: Destination alias
field.help: Fill this only when “Selected alias” is chosen above.
